ref_date_note: Monday plan (page shows post date Oct 4, 2025; batch list said 10/5). Z (Dec) contract, no roll mention. Brief plan (author travelling): no 'TRADES:' heading, but COMMENTARY is followed directly by 'Longs:' and 'Shorts:' subsections listing the trades, treated as the trades list. Friday lows given as numbers (ES '54.5' -> 6754.5, NQ 923.25) so gates/targets use the numbers instead of FRI_LOW. es1 states 6776-6780 plus 'expect 72 and 76 to print'; the '66-67' reaction area (6766-6767) is kept as a zone, not a target. es2 and nq2 are 'hold ... at open on Sunday' (Globex/ETH open) ideas, ungraded. es3 'reclaim and hold of 76-80' (he says he doesn't like reclaim longs) ungraded, classed break; 'retest of Friday's high' -> FRI_HIGH. nq1 has no explicit target; 'take profit if 969-980 rejects from below' -> 24969-24980 first target. nq3 can trigger from as high as 25066-25081. nq4 'I don't love breakdown shorts but holding below 969-980 should retest Friday's low' included ungraded as a break. Skipped: unplanned breakdown short below Friday's low. Weekly 6798-6801 (Friday high area) kept as zone.

trades.name: LBAF of Friday low (6754.5), basing above 6757-6760
trades.quote: A LBAF of the Friday ES low (54.5) which bases back above 6757-6760 should have the strength to see 6776-6780. I would monitor for a reaction in the 66-67 range but expect 72 and 76 to print. I’ll rate this an A-/B+

trades.name: Hold of 6757-6760 at Sunday open
trades.quote: A hold of 57-60 at open on Sunday can move toward these targets as well, but a failure from sellers (LBAF) likely strengthens the move.

trades.name: Reclaim and hold of 6776-6780
trades.quote: I don’t like reclaim longs but a reclaim and hold of 76-80 should see 87.5 with potential for a retest of Friday’s high.

trades.name: LBAF of Friday low (24923.25)
trades.quote: A LBAF of the Friday NQ low (923.25) is also a long, particularly given the 3 weekly levels sitting just below. We know that this must reclaim and base above 969-980 to find strength so I would take profit if 969-980 rejects from below. I’ll rate this a B/B+.
trades.stop_hint: this must reclaim and base above 969-980 to find strength so I would take profit if 969-980 rejects from below.

trades.name: Hold of 24969-24980 at Sunday open
trades.quote: A hold of 969-980 at open on Sunday should see at least 25004 with potential for 25020 and the weekly 25035-25046 spot. Monitor for continuation from there.

trades.name: Failure to reclaim 6776-6780 (incl. LAAF)
trades.quote: A failure to reclaim 76-80 (inclusive of a LAAF) targets 72, 66, and 57-60. Monitor for continuation. B rating.

trades.name: LAAF of 6787.5
trades.quote: A LAAF of 6787.5 would feel a tad risky but I would be open to it. While stronger sellers would perhaps defend by 76-80, 87.5 was the Friday premarket high and Friday’s VAH. Given we saw it take longer for ES to roll over on Friday I am open to it especially if there isn’t some kind of bullish setup active. If we see it the session would be in an uptrend so it may require patience. I would target 76-80 and below 80 the above targets come into play with perhaps more thrust. I’ll also rate this a B.

trades.name: Failed reclaim / LAAF of 25035-25046
trades.quote: For NQ I would short a failed reclaim (including a LAAF) of 25035-25046. This could come from as high as the 066-081 range) I would target 25004 and 24969-980 then monitor for potential continuation to and through Friday’s low whether I would be out of most of the position. I’ll rate this a B+/A-
trades.stop_hint: This could come from as high as the 066-081 range)

trades.name: Holding below 24969-24980 (breakdown)
trades.quote: I don’t love breakdown shorts but holding below 969-980 should retest Friday’s low.

trades.name: Failure to reclaim / LAAF of 25091-25099
trades.quote: While stronger sellers would defend lower, a failure to reclaim (or LAAF) 25091-25099 targets 25035-25046. This would really be pushing the bounds for a potential lower high (as in it might be too high for that) so I would exercise some caution. That said, we saw NQ retrace nearly to the IB high on Friday before selling off hard (a strong look for sellers). I’ll rate this a B.
